m: आट् ind. a croak (imitation of the sound uttered by a frog), TāṇḍyaBr.

s: klI, (AN + wIk + lyuw .) vatsAnAM gamanaM । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: na॰ AwIkyata Izadgamyate A + wIka--lyuw । vatsAnAM praTamamalpagatO svArTe kan tatrEva hArA~ lAntatayA pAWaH prAmAdikaH ।
m: आ-टीकन n. (√ टीक्), the leaping motion of a calf, L. (cf. आटीलक and आढील्˚.)
a: आटीकनं — [आटीक्-ल्युट्] The leaping motion of a calf; so आटीलकं.

m: आटीकर m. a bull, L.
आटीलक n. = आ-टीकन, q.v., L.
आटी-मेद m. N. of a bird, L.

v: na॰ AwyAH SarAriBedasya muKamiva muKamasya । suSrutokte SastraBede “sUcIkuSapatrAwImuKaSarArImuKetyAdi viMSatiSastragaRanAyAm suSru॰ ardDaDAraSabde vivftiH ।
m: आटी-मुख n. ‘the top of which is like the beak of the आटि’, a surgical instrument employed in blood-letting, Suśr.
आटी-मुख &c. See आटि.
आट्णार अस्, m. a descendant of Aṭṇāra, N. of Para, TS. v; ŚBr. xiii; TāṇḍyaBr.
= अटनशील, ‘fond of wandering’ (Comm.), Nir. i, 14.
आट mfn. (√ अट्), going, going after, only ifc., e.g. कन्याट, क्षपाट, पत्न्य्-आट &c.
आट m. N. of a Nāga demon, TāṇḍyaBr. (cf. आतक.)
आटक mf(इका)n. going. See कारस्कराटिका.
आटक m. a sparrow, L.

v: pu॰ awarUza eva svArTe aR । vAsakavfkze svArTe kan tatrEva “AwarUzakavarRRABAhayAH yAntyanuyAyinAm” BA॰ dro॰ pa॰ ।
m: आटरूष or आटरुष m. = अट्˚, q.v., L.
a: आटरूषः — [अटरूष एव, स्वार्थे अण्] N. of a tree, see अटरूष.

v: strI awavyAH sannikfzwA pUH aR । dakziRadiksTayavanapurIBede । sahadevadigvijayavarRRane । “dUtEreva vaSe cakre karaYcEnAnadApayat “pARqyAMSca draviqAMScEva sahitAMScoqrakeralEH । anDrAMstAlavanAMScEva kaliNgAnuzwrakarRRikAn । AwavIYca purIM ramyAM yavanAnAM puraM taTA” BA॰ sa॰ pa॰ ।
m: आटवी f. N. of a town, MBh. ii, 1175.
a: आटवी — [अटव्याः सन्निकृष्टा पूः अण्] N. of a city of the Yavanas in the south.

v: tri॰ awavyAM carati Bavo vA Wak । araRyacAriRi “pracCannavaYcakAstvete ye stenAwavikAdayaH” manuH “daRqezu suhftkumArAwAvikAH sAmantasEnikAdyASca” sA॰ da॰ 2 “sEnyaBede । sEnyAni ca zaqaviDAni । yaTA “mOlaM BftyaH suhfcCreRI dvizadAwavikaM balam” mallinATa DftakozaH । tadaBiprAyerRava “zaqviDaM balamadAyeti” raGuH ।
m: आटविक m. a woodman, forester.
आटविक m. (fr. अटवी), the inhabitant of a forest, Mn. ix, 257; MBh. &c.
a forester, Sāh.
आटविक mfn. consisting of inhabitants of the forest (as an army), Kām.
a: आटविकः — [अटव्यां चरति भवो वा ठक्] 1 A forester, a woodman, inhabitant of a forest. --2 A pioneer. --3 One of the six kinds of armies.

m: आटविन् m. N. of a teacher, VāyuP.
आटव्य m. v.l. for आटविन्, q.v.

s: puM, (AN + awa + in .) pakziviSezaH । SarAli iti KyAtaH । ityamaraH ॥
v: pu॰ A + aw--iR । 1 SarAripakziRi । 2 matsyaBede ca jAtitvena striyAM vA NIp । CAtryAdizu pAWAt SAlASabde pare'syodAttatvam ।
m: आटि f. N. of the bird Turdus Ginginianus, PārGṛ. (cf. आडि and आति.)
a: आटिः — [आ-अट्-इण्] 1 A kind of bird (शरारि) (also written आटि). --2 A sort of fish. --Comp. --मुखः, --खं a surgical instrument used in bloodletting (so called from its being like the beak of the bird आटि).

k.v: शरारिराटिराडिश्च बलाका बिसकण्ठिका। हंसस्य योषिद्वरटा सारसस्य तु लक्ष्मणा॥

v: strI Awam awanamarhati aR--NIp । gfhAdbahirgantumarhAyAmanupajAtapayoDarAyAM striyAm । “mawacIhatezu kuruzvAwikyA saha jAyayozastirha cAkrAyaRa iByagrAme pradrARa uvAsa” CA॰ u॰ । AwikyA'nupajAtapayoDarAdi strIvyaYjanayA jAyayA saha” iti BA॰ ।
m: आटिकी f. N. of the wife of Uṣasti, ChUp. [‘marriageable’ or ‘strolling about (fr. √ अट्)’ Comm.]

v: tri॰ AwAya gamanAya pravfttaH WaR । gamanapravftte svArTe zyaY । Awikyamapyatra na॰ ।
m: आटिक m. pl. N. of a School of the Yajus, AV.Pariś.
a: आटिक, आटिक्य — a. [आटाय गमनाय प्रवृत्तः ठण्, ष्यञ् वा] Able to wander, being on a voyage or journey. --की A woman fit to go out ( अनुपजातपयोधरादिस्त्रीव्यंजना Śaṅkara).

s: puM, (AN + wup + GaY .) darpaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ vAyujanya-udaraguqguqASabdaH । iti vEdyakaM ॥ (garvvaH, samBramaH, saMramBaH । yaTA-paYcatantre “vizaM Bavatu mAvABUt PawAwopo BayaNkaraH” । yaTA SiSupAlabaDe । ‘sAwopamurvvImaniSaM nadantaH’ । “AwopahfllAsavamIgurutvastEmityamAvAhakaPaprasekEH” । iti mADavakaraH ॥)
v: A + tupa--GaY pfzo॰ Watvam । 1 darpe, 2 saMramBe, 3 Aqambare ca । “sAwopamurvvImaniSaM nadantaH” mAGaH “madajaladurddinAnDakAragajaGawitaGanaGawAwopaparipAlitApi” kAda॰ “sAwopaM parikramya” veRI॰ “kalAparucirAwopanicitAn mukuwAniva” BA॰ va॰ pa॰ । 4 vAtajanye udaraSabdaBede “AmAwopApaciSlezmagulmekrimivikAriRAm” suSru॰ ।
m: आटोप m. puffing, swelling, MBh. iii, 11587; Pañcat. &c.
a multitude, redundancy, BhP.
flatulence, borborygmi, Suśr.
pride, self-conceit, Mṛcch. &c. (cf. सातोपम्.)
(also) haste, L.
a: आटोपः — [आ-तुप्-घंञ् पृषो˚ टत्वं Tv.] 1 Pride, self-conceit, arrogance; साटोपं proudly, in a stately or majestic manner, frequently used as a stage direction. --2 Swelling, spreading, expanding, puffing; Prov. फटाटोपो भयंकर; said also of clouds; अद्यापि साटोपा मेघा दृश्यंते Pt. 1; Śi. 3. 74. --3 Flatulence (in the belly).

m: आट्टस्थलीक mfn. fr. अट्ट-स्थली, (g. धूमादि, q.v., not in Kāś.)
